subject.declared_domain: The DUAL-AXIS exception to the relation vocabulary: three composites (projects, routes-to, resolves-through) that yield a base relation AND a role, where every other relation yields a relation only. It exists because that exception was previously a prose 'load-bearing subtlety' a classifier had to just know.

methodology.how: A hand-legislated YAML block, top-level key `relation_composites:` at line 149. Three members, each carrying `concrete` (the primary physical edge_type), `binds_up` (the base relation it reduces to), `role` (the role it additionally confers), and optionally `also` (further physical edge_types). Unlike #relations, whose members bind only upward, these bind on two axes at once -- which is precisely the property `comp-ontolint` was built to machine-check.
declared_opinions: The choice that exactly THREE relations are dual-axis is the block's entire content and it has no derivation. `comp-ontolint` enforces the INVARIANT (no base relation carries a `role`; every composite `role` is a declared role) but NOT the membership -- nothing tests whether a fourth relation ought to be here.
`resolves-through` declares `concrete: REFERENCES`, an edge_type with ZERO live instances. The composite is fully declared and entirely unexercised.
`projects` carries four extra physical types in `also` (PROJECTS_TO, ORIGIN, USES_OAI, USES_OAC) while the other two carry none -- an asymmetry with no stated reason.
